author: designer
label: A_s1_draft_sun
prompt:
SHOT: wide, eye level, 28mm at T2.8, slow dolly following him at walking pace, 25 fps.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: a young man in his early twenties, short dark-blond hair, navy wool suit and open white shirt, seen from behind, walks across a lakeside square toward an old pastel town house, climbs two stone steps and pushes its heavy wooden door open.
PLACE: a small Upper Austrian lake town: a wide calm lake on the left with mountains across the water, cobblestones, a row of pastel yellow and ochre town houses with plain painted facades and green shutters.
LIGHT: one low warm sun from camera-right just after sunrise, about 4:1, long soft shadows across the cobblestones, expose to protect the highlights.
COLOUR: soft pastel facades, deep blue-green water, natural skin, restrained and filmic.
SOUND: gentle lake water lapping, his footsteps on cobblestones, a church bell far away, the creak of the heavy door.
